observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a TV screen displaying the PS5 home menu with FC25 highlighted, along with icons for other games including Mortal Kombat 1 Ultimate, God of War, and others.
Photo 2 shows a custom-designed PS5 Slim console with a skin featuring a hooded character (likely from Ghost of Tsushima or similar game), with a pink DualSense controller resting on top.
The console is connected to the TV via a cable, and the screen in the background shows the Mortal Kombat 1 Ultimate game icon.
The console has a visible 'PS5' logo at the bottom front, confirming it is a PS5 model.
The seller claims the console includes FC25, GTA5, Mortal Kombat, Ragnarok, and Ghost of Tsushima.
No physical games or discs are visible in the photos; all games appear to be digital, as shown on the screen.
The console is not shown from the side or back, so ports, disc drive, or internal condition cannot be assessed.
The pink controller is likely a third-party or custom DualSense, not standard PS5 stock.
